page.title: Choose your subscription tier
page.intro:
If these benefits interest you, explore all available tiers and choose the one that suits you best.
Have questions? Join our Discord server or open a ticket at [patrons.sefinek.net/tickets](https://patrons.sefinek.net/tickets) - we typically respond within 24 hours.

tiers.1: The basic tier for people who simply want to support the project. A good choice if you've stopped playing Genshin Impact and no longer need the in-game benefits, but still want to support the project voluntarily.
tiers.2: The recommended tier, with the full set of Stella Mod benefits - Ray Tracing, mods, shaders, privacy protection, giveaways, and much more. Includes standard support for Stella Plus and Stella Mod.
tiers.3: For players who want to use Stella Mod on two devices and take advantage of PC optimization and technical assistance. Includes improved support.
tiers.4: The highest tier, with activation for three devices and priority support. Ideal for players who want the best possible experience and the fastest response times.

notes.voluntarySupport: A subscription is treated as voluntary support for the project, not as the purchase of a service or product. The benefits you receive are simply a token of appreciation. If you prefer, you can continue using the free version - the decision is entirely yours.
notes.freeVersionAvailable: The free version remains available and can be used without an account or subscription.
notes.spc: * SPC stands for Sefinek Patron Center, the patron panel available at [patrons.sefinek.net]({{url}})

payment.title: Payment system
payment.description: Payments are securely processed by [Stripe](https://stripe.com) - a globally trusted platform that supports all major cards and payment methods. Your financial data is encrypted and protected throughout the entire transaction, so you can subscribe with complete peace of mind.

rules.title: Rules for benefits and patronage
rules.intro: Before subscribing to Stella Mod Plus, please take a moment to read the following guidelines.

noPurchase.title: Subscription does not constitute a purchase of 3DMigoto:
noPurchase.text: By subscribing to Stella Mod Plus, you are not purchasing 3DMigoto as a digital product. You only receive access to use 3DMigoto within the Stella Mod Launcher application for the duration of your active subscription.

personalAccess.title: Access is personal and non-transferable:
personalAccess.text: Your benefit redemption token and access to Stella Mod Plus are assigned exclusively to your account and must remain confidential. Sharing, reselling, sublicensing, or granting access to anyone outside your household is strictly prohibited and may result in immediate loss of access without the right to a refund.

refunds.title: Refund policy:
refunds.text: Subscriptions constitute a digital service delivered immediately after payment. Refunds are generally not available, but may be considered individually in cases of technical payment errors or system failures that prevent access to benefits. In such situations, please contact us via ticket.

rules.footer: We appreciate your support for the project. If you have any questions or concerns, please open a [ticket]({{url}}). Following the rules above is very important to us.

request.subscribing: We need a little time to get everything ready. Please stay on this page and give us a moment! Shortly, we will redirect you to a secure payment page where you can safely complete your transaction.
request.changing: We need some time to change your tier. Give us a moment, and we will make sure everything goes smoothly.
